projects.name: Relay - Multi-Agent Collaboration for AI Coding CLIs
description: Built a single static Go binary that lets AI coding agents in separate terminals (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, Google Antigravity CLI) work as one team, handing work to each other and answering back.
Wrapped each tool in a pseudo-terminal (Unix PTY and Windows ConPTY) and exposed MCP tools for agent-to-agent messaging, while every terminal still behaves exactly like the tool itself.
Tracked each agent's busy, idle and dialog state from its own transcripts, logs and SQLite conversation database, so messages are typed only at safe moments and urgent ones interrupt a running turn.
Added global sessions across machines through a Go WebSocket server backed by PostgreSQL and MongoDB, alongside a local daemon over Unix sockets.

Kept a zero-footprint guarantee on users' tool configs, with byte-exact restore and crash recovery, verified by CI on Linux, macOS and Windows, fuzzing, and live end-to-end tests against the real tools.
